notes.title: The Latest from Astronomic Games!
notes.notes:
The latest from Astronomic Games: Snares of Ruin!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/766940/Snares_of_Ruin/

You are detective Hank Anderson , and you’ve just been transferred to another city to help solve a series of unusual crimes. Upon arrival, you are greeted with a gory scene and a revelation of several instances of a deadly disease that turns people into savage zombie-like husks.

Grab it now at 30% off!

notes.title: Mercury: Cascade into Madness needs your help now!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, please go and check out this great game on Greenlight and give it a thumbs up if you like it! 

With an urban sci-fi cyberpunk setting, Mercury takes place in a crime-ridden city where vigilante justice is a common occurrence with a choice and consequence aspect being a core part of the game's progression.

If this sounds interesting, please check it out on the link below! Everyone who's familiar with Astronomic games will know that they produce great games that are great fun and this is no exception! 

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=875866713

notes.title: Latest from New Reality Games, State of Anarchy: Master of Mayhem
notes.notes:
The sequel to State of Anarchy is here! 
we've reached the day of release and now the time to annihilate aliens is nigh, Huzzah!
Pick up State of Anarchy: Master of Mayhem now whilst it's on discount by clicking on the link below and please leave a review if you have the time!
If you have any constructive criticism or problems, please let us know so we can work on addressing them at once!
Happy shooting,
--Oliver

http://store.steampowered.com/app/576130/

notes.title: Latest From Astronomic Games, Mercury: Cascade into Madness!
notes.notes:
Astronomic Games are releasing their next game, but first we need your help to get it through Greenlight!
Mercury: Cascade into Madness is an urban sci-fi cyberpunk choice and consequence RPG with the same quality as seen in previous Astronomic Games' titles!
If this has peaked your interest, click on the link below to check it out and, if you like the look of it, give it a thumbs up to help make this fantastic game a reality!
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=875866713
